planets.name: Kepler-186 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-186 with a 3.89-day year, found in 2014.

text.card: Kepler-186 b was found in 2014 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 5 planets known around Kepler-186. Its orbit and size follow Quintana et al. 2014's fit, the archive's default.
